But that is hardly admissible here.—S'ikhariṇî.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r6", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. L.—इह = अस्मिन् संसारे Râmarshi says विश्वस्मिन् which I do", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "not understand. दुकूलैः is a better reading than च लक्ष्म्या as", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "marking better the contrast with वल्कलैः—निर्विशेषो विशेषः is some-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 5, "text": "what puzzling.
